# PermitPlace

> > PermitPlace is a commercial permit expediting and compliance services firm specializing in nationwide permit research, entitlements, and application management for multi-location business expansion.

PermitPlace brings 20+ years of expertise to commercial real estate development, serving 2,500+ clients across major US markets including California, Arizona, and Texas. The company offers integrated permitting solutions from due diligence research through final permit acquisition, with specialized programs for franchise expansion, liquor licensing, and industry-specific compliance.

## Core Permitting Services

- [Commercial Permitting Services | Expediting, Due Diligence & More](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services): PermitPlace core services: permit expediting, due diligence, entitlements.
- [Permit Expediter Services - Streamline Your Project](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services/permit-expediting): Permit expediting services across LA, SF, Seattle, and Arizona with SLA.
- [Due Diligence Reports | Permit Place](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services/due-diligence-reports): Due diligence reports for investment decisions and permit planning.
- [Permit Records Research Services](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services/permit-research): Property construction history and permit records research services.
- [Entitlement Services and Planning Zoning](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services/entitlements): Entitlement services for zoning, conditional use, and rezoning permits.
- [Permit Application Running Services](https://permitplace.com/permit-running-services): Permit running services with nationwide notary network for same-day submission.

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Industries Served | PermitPlace](https://permitplace.com/industries-served): PermitPlace industries: restaurants, retail, banks, solar, EV charging.

- [California Restaurant Liquor License: Types, Costs & How to Apply](https://permitplace.com/permitting-services/liquor-license): Guide to California liquor license types, costs, and 90-day application process.
- [Bank & Financial Institution Permitting USA](https://permitplace.com/industries-served/banks): Bank and financial institution permit expediting for multi-location expansion.
- [Grocer and Convenience Store Permit Expediting](https://permitplace.com/industries-served/convenience-stores): Grocery and convenience store permits with liquor license entitlements.
- [EV Charging Station Permits | Get Permit for EV Charging Station](https://permitplace.com/industries-served/ev-charging-station-permits): EV charging station permit expediting for single and multi-location setup.
- [Hotel Permitting & Entitlement Services](https://permitplace.com/industries-served/hotels): Hotel permits covering ADA compliance, fire safety, and liquor licenses.
